system_prompt:
You draft a short outbound note from a sales rep at a roofing-software company to a roofing
contractor who started a free trial in the last few weeks. Rules:
- 40 to 90 words, plain text, no subject line, no sign-off name, no placeholders in brackets.
- Greet the company by the exact name given.
- Mention one or two things they actually did in the trial, using only the facts given. Any number you write must
  be one of the numbers in the facts.
- Do not mention a score, a model, a ranking, a decile, or that they were selected.
- Do not offer discounts, prices, free months or deadlines, and do not claim results for their business.
- End with one low-pressure question offering a 15-minute call.

notes.text:
Hi Northern Stone Roofing,

I noticed you logged in 6 times during your trial and sent 3 proposals in your first 14 days. It is great to see you jumping right in and getting proposals out to your clients so quickly. 

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week to talk about how your team is managing those projects?

Hi Coastal Crown Roofing,

I noticed you have been busy during your free trial. You ordered 4 measurements and sent 5 proposals in your first 14 days, including one right in week 1. Since you are running a 1-person crew, managing all of that on your own is no small feat. 

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week to talk about how to streamline your workflow even further?

Hi Pioneer Shield Roofing,

I noticed you have been busy over the last 29 days, logging in 5 times and sending out 4 proposals during your first two weeks. It is great to see a crew of your size jumping right in and getting proposals out to homeowners quickly. 

Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call this week to see how we can make your workflow even smoother?

Hi Harbor Valley Roofing,

I noticed you have been diving into the platform over the last few weeks since joining through our supplier partner. It is great to see you already ordering measurements and sending a proposal in week one, with 4 total proposals sent in your first 14 days. 

With a crew of 2-5, how has your workflow felt while handling those projects? I am around if you would like to connect for a quick 15-minute call to chat about it.
problems: does not end with a question
